exposure: positive genetic test for high-risk breast cancer genes
cohort: Females with positive genetic tests for high-risk breast cancer genes who underwent prophylactic or contralateral prophylactic mastectomies at a tertiary-care hospital were included.
finding: No occult breast cancer was identified in prophylactic/contralateral prophylactic mastectomy cases, and sentinel lymph node biopsy results were consistently negative, though atypical ductal hyperplasia was found in 11.5% of specimens, suggesting SLNB can be safely omitted in CPM patients after preoperative assessment.
